description: User settings for authama. Precedence: command-line flags > environment > <config home>/.env > authama.json > defaults.

$schema.description: The schema this file follows (for editors).

age_recipient.description: The age recipient (public key) bundles are encrypted to. Required for `ssh bundle` and the backups destructive commands take first. Sets $AUTHAMA_AGE_RECIPIENT.

old_key_max_age_days.description: Days an archived predecessor key may stay before doctor flags it; 0 turns the check off. Sets $AUTHAMA_OLD_KEY_MAX_AGE_DAYS. Default: 90.

snapshot_retain.description: How many ~/.ssh snapshots to keep. Sets $AUTHAMA_SNAPSHOT_RETAIN. Default: 10.

hypervisor.description: A built-in hypervisor (parallels, vmpal, vmware, utm, lima) or one from the hypervisors section.

key.description: The key name the host uses; a loose ~/.ssh/<key> pair is adopted (copied) when the profile has no key of that name.

profile.description: The profile the host belongs to (created when missing).

vm.description: The VM's name as the hypervisor lists it. Leave it out for a planned devbox that only keeps its key.

devboxes.description: Devboxes authama keeps as SSH hosts, by alias. `ssh vm sync` adds a declared devbox that is not a host yet and adopts its loose key (a copy) when the profile lacks it. A devbox without vm is planned: it only keeps its key (doctor reports it as reserved) until the VM exists.

mode.description: How `ssh git` rewrites remotes. Sets $AUTHAMA_GIT_MODE. Default: the manifest's defaults.git.mode, else profile.

enabled.description: Record every change in the history database (`authama history`). Sets $AUTHAMA_HISTORY. Default: true.

address.description: Prints where the VM's SSH server answers: host or host:port.

exec.description: Runs a command in the guest; the guest argv is appended (optional; lets `ssh vm sync` re-install a missing key).

list.description: Lists the VMs: a JSON array of {"name","state"} (optional boolean "running"), or one name<TAB>state per line. running, started and up mean running.

start.description: Starts the VM (optional; without it `ssh` to a stopped VM fails instead of starting it).

hypervisors.description: Custom hypervisors: a command driver per name, for a VM tool authama has no built-in driver for. Each value is an argv array (no shell); {vm} is replaced with the VM's name. Enable one by naming it in vm.hypervisors (or leave that unset).

desktop.description: Show desktop notifications for keys due for rotation and dangling keys. Sets $AUTHAMA_NOTIFICATIONS. Default: true.

age_identity_file.description: The age identity (private key) `ssh restore` decrypts bundles with. Sets $AUTHAMA_AGE_IDENTITY_FILE.

state_dir.description: Where authama keeps its own state: the history database and audit log, snapshots, bundles, the lock and caches. Sets $AUTHAMA_STATE_DIR. Default: $XDG_STATE_HOME/authama or ~/.local/state/authama.

tokens_catalog.description: A catalog.json to use instead of the built-in token services and providers. Sets $AUTHAMA_TOKENS_CATALOG. Default: the built-in catalog.

tokens_config.description: The token config: which environment variables build which registry credential. Sets $AUTHAMA_TOKENS_CONFIG. Default: ./authama-tokens.json, else <config home>/tokens.json.

auto_pin.description: Pin a new host's key on first use (trust on first use) when a profile is minted. Sets $AUTHAMA_AUTO_PIN. Default: true.

docker_creds_store.description: What to do with registries Docker keeps in a credential store: store them with `docker login` or refuse and warn. Sets $AUTHAMA_DOCKER_CREDS_STORE. Default: ask at a terminal, else refuse.

hypervisors.description: The hypervisors you have and use, comma-separated (e.g. "parallels,vmpal"). `ssh vm list`, `ssh vm sync`, doctor and the web UI query only these; a VM host on another hypervisor is reported, never changed. Sets $AUTHAMA_VM_HYPERVISORS. Default: every built-in driver and every custom one in the hypervisors section.

prune_gone.description: Let `ssh vm sync` remove the host entry (never its key files) and Docker context of a VM its hypervisor no longer has. Off: sync only reports it. Sets $AUTHAMA_VM_PRUNE_GONE. Default: true.

repin_changed.description: Let `ssh vm sync` replace a VM host's known_hosts pin when the guest's host key changed (a rebuilt VM), as `--repin` does. Off: sync reports it. Sets $AUTHAMA_VM_REPIN. Default: false.

addr.description: The address `serve` listens on. A non-loopback address still needs --allow-remote. Sets $AUTHAMA_WEB_ADDR. Default: 127.0.0.1.

base_path.description: A path the web UI is served under, such as /authama, so it can sit behind a reverse proxy beside other sites. Every link, form and redirect carries it. Sets $AUTHAMA_WEB_BASE_PATH. Default: /.

port.description: The port `serve` listens on first. When it is taken the next free one is used, as with the default; only --port makes a taken port an error. Sets $AUTHAMA_WEB_PORT. Default: 7822.
